title: Bind automatic isolated supervisor repair and validated promotion
repair_contract: one reproduced defect opens one repair task; pid and attempt do not open a second writer
Grok is bound through ipfs_accelerate_py.llm_router and is not launched by this adapter
edits land only in a campaign-owned repair worktree
the only editable paths are the new reproducer and the reproduced source frames
regressions and the canary gate promotion; the canary cannot promote itself
promotion is a native merge receipt, then reload and fence
rollback evidence is retained and a checkpoint cannot refund a spent repair
limitations: The adapter binds the canonical llm_router explicit-agent argv and applies admitted edits in the repair worktree. It does not launch Grok, Codex, or a hosted model.
Native merge and reload are checked from their receipts. This adapter does not invent a git commit or restart a lane by itself.
The repair budget is DEFAULT_LIMITS['repair'] from the WWL-100 progress ledger, which is 2. The campaign cap is 8 opened writers. A checkpoint cannot refund either count.
Unknown effects, holds, and deadlines admit no repair mutation. A canary cannot set validated promotion or grant completion authority.
The sealed interpreter /usr/bin/python3.12 does not provide pytest on the authoritative PATH. The repair suite was executed with the workspace virtualenv that provides pytest 9.1.1.
This receipt does not grant campaign completion or task completion.
